jobs.description:
Il candidato selezionato sarà responsabile della gestione dei rischi legati alla Gestione Attivi-Passivi (ALM) e al rischio di liquidità, garantendo che l'azienda mantenga una solida posizione finanziaria e possa affrontare efficacemente le sfide di mercato.

Responsabilità Principali:

• Condurre un'analisi approfondita dei rischi legati ad ALM e al rischio di liquidità, identificando potenziali vulnerabilità e sviluppando strategie di mitigazione

• Monitorare la posizione di liquidità giornaliera dell'azienda, garantendo il rispetto dei requisiti normativi e interni in conformità con il framework di Basilea e l'ordinanza FINMA

• Collaborare con i dipartimenti del tesoro e della finanza per ottimizzare le pratiche di gestione della liquidità, inclusa la previsione dei flussi di cassa, la gestione del buffer di liquidità e le strategie di finanziamento/piano di contingenza

• Valutare e gestire l'esposizione dell'azienda al rischio di tasso di interesse nel banking book (IRRBB), sviluppando strategie per mitigare impatti negativi sui guadagni e sul capitale

• Condurre test di stress sulla liquidità e analisi di scenari per valutare l'impatto di condizioni di mercato avverse sulla posizione di liquidità dell'azienda

• Preparare rapporti dettagliati e accurati sul rischio di liquidità e ALM per la direzione senior, il Comitato, i Regolatori, fornendo un'analisi chiara e raccomandazioni

• Capacità di lavorare sotto pressione in un ambiente dinamico stabilendo priorità e rispettando scadenze ristrette

• Competenze Tecniche: Conoscenza avanzata di ALM e rischio di liquidità, strumenti e metodologie di gestione del rischio di tasso di interesse, inclusa l'analisi di scenari e i test di stress

• Competenze Analitiche: Eccellenti capacità analitiche e attenzione ai dettagli, con la capacità di interpretare e sintetizzare grandi volumi di dati complessi utilizzando conoscenze di programmazione (Python, R, SQL)

• Competenze Comunicative: Forti capacità comunicative scritte e verbali, con la capacità di presentare informazioni tecniche in modo chiaro e conciso a stakeholder non tecnici

• Esperienza: Almeno 3 anni di esperienza nella gestione del rischio, con particolare attenzione ad ALM/rischio di liquidità o al dipartimento del tesoro

• Lingue: Conoscenza madrelingua di italiano/inglese, francese/tedesco è un plus

• Certificazione professionale in gestione del rischio (ad es. FRM, PRM) è un plus

• Residente in Ticino o disponibile a trasferirsi

descriptionByLocale.en:
Description

The selected candidate will be responsible for managing risks related to the Active-Passive Management (ALM) and liquidity risk, ensuring that the company maintains a sound financial position and can effectively address market challenges.

Tasks

- Conduct an in-depth analysis of the risks related to ALM and liquidity risk, identifying potential vulnerabilities and developing mitigation strategies - Snap the company's daily liquidity position, ensuring compliance with regulatory and internal requirements in accordance with the Basel framework and the FINMA order - Collaborate with the Treasury and Finance Departments to optimise liquidity management practices, including cash flow forecasting, the management of buffer liquidity and financing strategies/quota plan -

Assessing and managing the company's exposure to interest rate risk in the banking book (IRRBB), developing strategies to mitigate negative impacts on earnings and capital - Conduct stress tests on liquidity and scenario analyses to assess the impact of adverse market conditions on the company's liquidity position - Prepare detailed and accurate reports on liquidity risk and ALM for the senior management of the Tehran, the Committee, regulators, providing a clear analysis and recommendations - Ability to work under pressure in a dynamic environment setting priorities

and respecting limited deadlines

Technical competence

- Advanced knowledge of ALM and liquidity risk, instruments and methodologies for managing interest rate risk, including analysis of scenarios and stress tests

Analytical Skills

- Excellent analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to interpret and synthesize large volumes of complex data using programming knowledge (Python, R, SQL)

Communication skills

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present technical information in a clear and concise manner to non-technical Christiardi

Requirements

- At least 3 years of experience in risk management, with particular attention to ALM/liquidity risk or the Treasury Department - Knowledge of native speakers of Italian/English, French/German is a plus - Professional certification in risk management (ad es. FRM, PRM) is a plus -299e in Ticino or available to move
descriptionByLocale.de:
Warenbezeichnung

Der ausgewählte Kandidat ist für das Management von Risiken im Zusammenhang mit dem Active-Passive Management (ALM) und dem Liquiditätsrisiko verantwortlich, um sicherzustellen, dass das Unternehmen eine solide Finanzlage behält und sich den Herausforderungen des Marktes effektiv stellen kann.

Aufgaben

- eine eingehende Analyse der Risiken im Zusammenhang mit ALM und Liquiditätsrisiko, Ermittlung potenzieller Schwachstellen und Entwicklung von Minderungsstrategien - die tägliche Liquiditätsposition des Unternehmens zu überbrücken, die Einhaltung der regulatorischen und internen Anforderungen gemäß dem Baseler Rahmen und dem FINMA-Ordnung zu gewährleisten - Zusammenarbeit mit den Schatz- und Finanzabteilungen zur Optimierung der Liquiditätsmanagementpraktiken, einschließlich Cashflow-Prognosen, Verwaltung der Pufferliquidität und Finanzierungsstrategien/Quotenplan -

Die Bewertung und Verwaltung des Risikos des Unternehmens gegenüber dem Zinsrisiko im Bankenbuch (IRRBB), die Entwicklung von Strategien zur Abschwächung negativer Auswirkungen auf Ertrag und Kapital - Durchführung von Stresstests auf Liquidität und Szenarioanalysen zur Bewertung der Auswirkungen ungünstiger Marktbedingungen auf die Liquiditätsposition des Unternehmens - Erstellung detaillierter und genauer Berichte über Liquiditätsrisiken und ALM für das Geschäftsleitungsgremium des Teheraner Ausschusses, der Regulierungsbehörden, Bereitstellung einer klaren Analyse und Empfehlungen - Fähigkeit, unter Druck in einem dynamischen Umfeld zu arbeiten, Prioritätensetzung

und Einhaltung begrenzter Fristen

Technische Kompetenz

- Erweiterte Kenntnisse über ALM- und Liquiditätsrisiken, Instrumente und Methoden zur Steuerung des Zinsrisikos, einschließlich Analyse von Szenarien und Stresstests

Analytische Fähigkeiten

- Ausgezeichnete analytische Fähigkeiten und Liebe zum Detail, mit der Fähigkeit, große Mengen komplexer Daten mit Programmierkenntnissen zu interpretieren und zu synthesieren (Python, R, SQL)

Kommunikationskompetenz

- Starke schriftliche und verbale Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit, technische Informationen klar und prägnant zu präsentieren, um nicht-technische Christiardi

- Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Risikomanagement, mit besonderer Aufmerksamkeit auf das ALM/Liquiditätsrisiko oder das Treasury Department - Kenntnisse der Muttersprachler von Italienisch/Englisch, Französisch/Deutsch ist ein Plus - Professionelle Zertifizierung im Risikomanagement (AD es. FRM, PRM) ist ein Plus - 299e im Tessin oder verfügbar zu bewegen

Description

We are looking for a motivated and customer-oriented professional to join our team in a dynamic and growing environment. The ideal candidate is eager to develop his/her skills in managing customer relationships and debt recovery, combining strong communication skills with empathy and a solution-oriented approach. This role offers the opportunity to work closely with customers, negotiate sustainable payment solutions and help maintain positive and professional relationships even in sensitive situations.

Main responsibilities

- Contact with customers for credit management and debt recovery - Active listening of customer situations and identification of sustainable payment solutions - Negotiation of repayment plans and monitoring of agreed agreements - Management and updating of cases in internal systems - Collaboration with the team to monitor open positions - Maintaining a professional and empathic approach even in sensitive situations

Requirements

- Commercial training (commercial apprenticeship or equivalent qualification) - German native language and good knowledge of English - Excellent communicative skills and strong customer listening skills - Able to manage customer relations by phone - Empathy, mediation skills and solution-oriented mentality - Attention to details and organizational skills - Team spirit and reliability

Ideal profile

- Young and motivated person eager to grow professionally - Ability to remain calm and professional even in difficult conversations - Team-oriented activity and collaborative mentality

Diese Rolle bietet die Möglichkeit, eng mit Kunden zusammenzuarbeiten, nachhaltige Zahlungslösungen auszuhandeln und auch in sensiblen Situationen positive und professionelle Beziehungen zu pflegen.

Description

We are looking for a motivated and detailed, motivated, and detailed, R&D-oriented, R&D team. You will be responsible for managing the legal recovery of debts and support for recovery strategies within the framework of the Swiss Debt and Bankruptcy Act (SchKG) and applicable financial products and consumer credit regulations.

This role requires close cooperation with internal HDDs, external legal partners and debtors to maximise recovery results while maintaining a professional and customer-oriented approach.

What We Offer

- Fixed position in a dynamic and international working environment. - Competitive salary and a package of benefits. - Location located in Wallisellen (Zürich), with partially remote work possibilities (smart 0020). - Complete program of insertion and training during the first three months at our office in Lugano. - Opportunities for professional growth and development within an expanding organization.

Key Responsibility

- Manage a portfolio of late accounts and start, monitor and follow the procedures for legal debt recovery. - Prepare, disable and process legal documentation, maintain precise case records and monitor ongoing legal proceedings to ensure timely follow-up. - Interact with debtors, legal representatives, debt recovery agencies, courts and public authorities, and negotiate payment plans and settlement agreements when appropriate.

- Assess recovery cases, recommend appropriate legal actions and support the achievement of recovery goals. - Collaborate with internal departments, including Customer Assistance, and contribute to the continuous improvement of recovery processes and recovery strategies.

Requirements

- A solid understanding of Swiss debt enforcement and insolvency procedures, together with familiarity with financial products and consumer credit regulations, would be an advantage. - Fluent in French (C1 level, written and spoken) and good skills in Italian (B2 level, written and spoken). The knowledge of German is considered an advantage.

jobs.title: Consulente Fiscale (Private Banking)  - ref. 1117
jobs.description:
Cerchiamo un Consulente Fiscale esperto da inserire nella Divisione Private Banking. La figura sarà il punto di riferimento tecnico per la clientela privata e commerciale residente in Svizzera, ma non solo, lavorando in stretta sinergia con i consulenti alla clientela e lo specialista previdenziale svizzero, per offrire una consulenza patrimoniale integrata e di alto profilo.

Il candidato ideale possiede una profonda conoscenza della fiscalità svizzera e una spiccata attitudine alla consulenza diretta ("in salotto"), combinando competenza tecnica e capacità relazionali.

• Formazione: Laurea in Economia, Giurisprudenza o titolo equipollente. È preferibile il possesso di un Master in Fiscalità (o titolo equivalente di Esperto Fiscale).

• Esperienza: comprovata esperienza pregressa in ambito fiscale, preferibilmente presso banche, fiduciarie o studi di consulenza fiscale con esposizione a clientela privata e commerciale.

• Competenze Tecniche: conoscenza approfondita e aggiornata del sistema fiscale svizzero (imposte dirette, successioni, donazioni, imposta preventiva, ecc.) e principi di diritto fiscale internazionale.

• Lingue: Ottima padronanza di almeno due lingue nazionali (preferenza italiano/tedesco) e dell'inglese (scritto e parlato).

• Soft Skills:

• eccellenti capacità comunicative e attitudine alla relazione con il cliente.

• spiccata predisposizione al lavoro di squadra e alla condivisione delle competenze.

• autonomia, orientamento ai risultati e massima discrezione.

• capacità di sintesi e di traduzione di concetti tecnici complessi in soluzioni comprensibili per il cliente.

• Residenza in Ticino o volontà di trasferimento

Responsabilità principali
• Consulenza ai clienti: supportare i clienti nelle tematiche fiscali legate agli investimenti, alla pianificazione patrimoniale e successoria ed alle tematiche societarie;

• Collaborazione interdisciplinare: lavorare all’interno del Team di Consulenza fiscale e previdenziale in sinergia con il collega dedicato alla consulenza previdenziale per soddisfare esigenze e richieste dei clienti da un lato e supportare i Relationship Manager nell’analisi e nello sviluppo del book di clienti;

• Supportare i servizi operativi (PBBS) nella gestione e risoluzione di problematiche relative alle attestazioni fiscali svizzere ed estere, interfacciandosi quando necessario con l’Amministrazione federale delle contribuzioni (AFC);

• Gestire, analizzare e validare, d’intesa con il PBBS ed in linea con le rispettive competenze, gli attestati fiscali, garantendone correttezza e conformità normativa;

• Fornire supporto al Team Strategia di Investimento nell’ambito della fiscalità dei prodotti finanziari con particolare riferimento alla clientela residente in Svizzera ed in via residuale a clientela residente in mercati rilevanti per la Banca;

• Gestione network esterno: coordinarsi con studi legali e fiscali esterni per la gestione di casi complessi, tematiche di pianificazione successoria, protezione patrimoniale e per indirizzare il cliente qualora fossero necessarie consulenze specialistiche esterne al perimetro bancario.

• Aggiornamento continuo: monitorare costantemente l’evoluzione della normativa fiscale svizzera e internazionale, garantendo l'aggiornamento costante della banca e dei colleghi sui temi rilevanti.

• Autonomia operativa: gestire richieste e progetti in modo autonomo, garantendo un elevato standard di servizio e riservatezza.

• Supporto alla Banca: puntualmente potranno essere formulate richieste di primo supporto per tematiche fiscali svizzere inerenti all’applicazione di imposte preventiva, IVA, Tassa di bollo di negoziazione (lista non esaustiva) per i servizi di Corporate Center (Finanze) e Back-office mercati.

descriptionByLocale.en:
We are seeking an experienced Tax Advisor to join our Private Banking Division. The successful candidate will serve as the technical point of contact for private and commercial clients residing in Switzerland and beyond, working closely with client advisors and the Swiss pension specialist to provide integrated, high-level wealth management advice.

The ideal candidate possesses in-depth knowledge of Swiss taxation and a strong aptitude for direct client consulting (“face-to-face”), combining technical expertise with interpersonal skills.

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Law, or an equivalent degree. A Master’s degree in Taxation (or an equivalent qualification as a Tax Expert) is preferred.

• Experience: Proven prior experience in the tax field, preferably at banks, trust companies, or tax consulting firms with exposure to private and commercial clients.

• Technical Skills: In-depth and up-to-date knowledge of the Swiss tax system (direct taxes, inheritance, gifts, withholding tax, etc.) and the principles of international tax law.

• Languages: Excellent command of at least two national languages (preferably Italian/German) and English (written and spoken).

Soft Skills:

• Excellent communication skills and a knack for building client relationships.

• Strong aptitude for teamwork and sharing expertise.

• Independence, results-oriented mindset, and the utmost discretion.

• Ability to synthesize information and translate complex technical concepts into solutions that clients can understand.

• Resident in Ticino or willing to relocate

Key Responsibilities

• Client Consulting: Support clients on tax matters related to investments, wealth and estate planning, and corporate issues;

• Interdisciplinary Collaboration: Work within the Tax and Pension Advisory Team in synergy with the colleague dedicated to pension advisory services to meet clients’ needs and requests, while also supporting Relationship Managers in analyzing and developing the client portfolio;

• Support operational services (PBBS) in managing and resolving issues related to Swiss and foreign tax certifications, liaising with the Federal Tax Administration (FTA) as needed;

• Manage, analyze, and validate, in consultation with the PBBS and in accordance with respective areas of expertise, tax certificates, ensuring their accuracy and regulatory compliance;

• Provide support to the Investment Strategy Team regarding the tax treatment of financial products, with particular focus on clients residing in Switzerland and, to a lesser extent, clients residing in markets relevant to the Bank;

• External network management: coordinate with external law and tax firms to handle complex cases, estate planning matters, and asset protection, and to refer clients to external specialists when necessary.

• Continuous professional development: constantly monitor developments in Swiss and international tax regulations, ensuring that the bank and colleagues remain up to date on relevant issues.

• Operational autonomy: Manage requests and projects independently, ensuring a high standard of service and confidentiality.

• Bank Support: Requests for initial support may be submitted as needed regarding Swiss tax matters related to the application of withholding tax, VAT, and transaction stamp tax (non-exhaustive list) for the Corporate Center (Finance) and Markets Back Office services.

descriptionByLocale.en:
We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented professional to join our team in a dynamic and customer-focused environment. This role combines client interaction with financial analysis, offering the opportunity to support customers in identifying suitable solutions while ensuring accurate assessment of their financial capacity and risk profile.

Key Responsibilities:

• Managing customer interactions via phone and email

• Actively listening to client needs and supporting the identification of suitable solutions

• Analyzing financial documentation, including salary slips and financial statements

• Conducting preliminary assessments of credit risk and clients’ financial capacity

• Collaborating with the team on case processing and monitoring

• Maintaining and updating data in internal systems

• Excellent knowledge of at least three of the following languages: Italian, German, French, and English

• Commercial training or equivalent qualification

• Strong communication skills and active listening abilities

• Interest in and ability to analyze financial data (salary slips, financial statements, economic documentation)

• Analytical mindset and accuracy in risk assessment

• Team spirit, reliability, and sense of responsibility

• Good IT skills, including proficiency with spreadsheets

• Resident in Ticino or willing to relocate

Ideal Profile:

• Young, curious individual with a strong willingness to learn

• Professional and customer-oriented approach

• Ability to work in a structured and organized manner
